description: TRECHO COM REDE DE ESGOTO BELO HORIZONTE is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Informação da disponibilidade de rede subterrânea projetada para evacuar esgotos domésticos ou outro de águas residuais na qual faz parte dos sistemas de limpeza urbana, por trechos de logradouro no município de Belo Horizonte. Frequência de Atualização: DIÁRIA. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Rede, Esgoto, Copasa, Básico, Saneamento. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
